test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Potantial."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the misspelt word is **"Potantial."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'Potential'.**
 
• **"Potential"** means having or showing the capacity to become or develop into something in the future. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु में विद्यमान गुण या क्षमताएँ जो अभी तक पूर्णतया विकसित नहीं)
 
 
• **Example**: *She has the **potential**__ to become a great singer.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Mimic)** means a person who can copy somebody’s behaviour, movements, voice, etc. in an amusing way. (मज़ाकिया ढंग से दूसरों के व्‍यवहार, हरकतों आवाज़ आदि की नक़ल उतारने वाला; नक़लची, स्‍वाँगी)
 
• **Option 3 (Grease)** means a thick oily substance, especially one used as a lubricant. (ग्रीज़; तेल वाला गाढ़ा पदार्थ जिससे इंजन आसानी से चलता है)
 
• **Option 4 (Surge)** means a sudden strong movement in a particular direction by a large number of people or things. (बहुत सारे व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं की एक विशेष दिशा में उमड़ पड़ने की क्रिया)
